_comment: The ignore list is the point of this file. `uploads/` receives every image
and video an admin adds through the CMS, and `backups/` receives a file
each time a migration or cleanup script runs. Watching either means the
server restarts mid-upload — the request dies, the admin sees a network
error, and the file is already on disk with no database row pointing at
it. `logs/` is worse: the server writes to it, so a restart triggers a
Use `npm run dev` rather than `npm start` while developing. `start` runs
plain node, which does not reload, so edits to routes or models are
silently ignored until the process is killed by hand.
